run_whatsapp_webhook_server: run a fastapi server that handles WhatsApp webhook POST requests at /webhook
create_whatsapp_message_model: create a pydantic BaseModel to parse WhatsApp webhook entry data with object and entry fields
handle_text_messages: handle incoming WhatsApp text messages and reply using an LLM via background tasks
handle_image_messages: handle incoming WhatsApp image messages by extracting media ID and caption for LLM processing
handle_audio_messages: handle incoming WhatsApp audio messages by converting and sending audio replies back to users
